author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects the use of Rufus, a utility used to create bootable USB drives. The threat actor Black Basta has been known to use a droper that mimics the legitimate Rufus software.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=1 AND (FileName LIKE '%rufus-%' ESCAPE '\' AND Process LIKE '%rufus-%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Rufus Bootable USB Utility - Sysmon

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects the use of AdFind and 7zip executables from Temp folders. QuantumLocker is known to use these tools during reconnaissance.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=1 AND (Image LIKE '%\\Temp\\AdFind.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Temp\\7.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: QuantumLocker reconnaissance tool processes - Sysmon

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects the use of AdFind and 7zip executables from Temp folders. QuantumLocker is known to use these tools during reconnaissance.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Temp\\AdFind.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Temp\\7.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: QuantumLocker reconnaissance tool processes - Generic

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects the file created on an infected endpoint by the Black Basta threat actor containing internal IP addresses used for targeting when deploying ransomware. Typically found on domain controllers.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=11 AND (TargetFileName LIKE 'pc\_list.txt' ESCAPE '\' AND FolderPath LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Black Basta IP Address Target List

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects when an ISO is mounted via the VHDMP event channel
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name='VHDMP' AND EventID=12)
title: ISO file mounted (VHDMP)

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects setting the desktop wallpaper registry key to the Black Basta ransom note
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=13 AND (EventType='SetValue' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control Panel\\Desktop%' ESCAPE '\' AND Details LIKE '%dlaksjdoiwq.jpg%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Set Black Basta Wallpaper Registry Key - Sysmon

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects setting the desktop wallpaper registry key to the Black Basta ransom note
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (EventType='SetValue' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control Panel\\Desktop%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%dlaksjdoiwq.jpg%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Set Black Basta Wallpaper Registry Key - Generic

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects setting the value for the registry key made by Black Basta ransomware that associates an icon with the .basta extension (V1) or the generated 9-character alphanumeric extension (V2) for encrypted files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=13 AND (EventType='SetValue' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Classes\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%DefaultIcon' ESCAPE '\' AND Details LIKE '\%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\fkdjsadasd.ico' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Set Black Basta Default Icon Registry Key - Sysmon

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects setting the value for the registry key made by Black Basta ransomware that associates an icon with the .basta extension (V1) or the generated 9-character alphanumeric extension (V2) for encrypted files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (EventType='SetValue' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Classes\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%DefaultIcon' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '\%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\fkdjsadasd.ico' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Set Black Basta Default Icon Registry Key - Generic

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects adding the registry key made by QuantumLocker that associates the .quantum file extension
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND (EventID=12 AND (EventType='CreateKey' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Classes\\.quantum%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Set QuantumLocker file extension registry key - Sysmon

author: Aaron Hoffmann
description: Detects adding the registry key made by QuantumLocker that associates the .quantum file extension
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='New registry value created') AND (EventType='CreateKey' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Classes\\.quantum%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Set QuantumLocker file extension registry key - Generic
